label: input v at step 3 in sequences starting d ? z v
explanation: Extremely sparse (23 of 1M sequences, one activation each). On dev every activation is at original-phase step 3, where the input is v, the previous input is z, and the first token is d (pattern d ? z v), and in every case L is 4 or 5. The predicate catches every dev activation (recall 1.0) but only about a third of the d ? z v prefixes fire. Magnitude depends on the token at position 1: letters (w, e, f) give 0.25-0.30, digits (2, 3) give only 0.03-0.07. It never fires at the delimiter, in the copy phase, or at any other step. With 5 dev examples, I cannot tell why some letter-middle cases (s, h, y, q, b, l) stay silent.
